reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: New York
    focus_year: 2021

    Question:
    "Is it required that the evictions summons served to tenants state the retaliatory eviction is unlawful?"
*/

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Basic helpers (no external modules)
------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

memberchk(X, [X|_]) :- !.
memberchk(X, [_|T]) :- memberchk(X, T).

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

scenario_state(new_york).
scenario_year(2021).

% There is an eviction-related court document characterized as a "summons"
scenario_document(eviction_summons_1).
scenario_document_type(eviction_summons_1, summons).
scenario_served_to(eviction_summons_1, tenant_1).

% The underlying issue raised by the question: "retaliatory eviction"
scenario_allegation(eviction_summons_1, retaliatory_eviction).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(new_york),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_document(Doc),
    scenario_document_type(Doc, summons),
    scenario_served_to(Doc, _Tenant),
    scenario_allegation(Doc, retaliatory_eviction).

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* [1] NY Real Prop Tax L  731 (2021) - Appointment of hearing officers / disqualification
   These provisions concern small claims assessment review hearing officers (tax assessment),
   not eviction summons/petitions. Encoded for completeness.
*/

% Deterministic test: disqualification required if conflict_of_interest or direct/indirect property interest.
rptl_731_disqualification_required(Officer, Property) :-
    (   rptl_731_conflict_of_interest(Officer)
    ->  true
    ;   rptl_731_direct_or_indirect_interest(Officer, Property)
    ->  true
    ;   false
    ).

% Conflict of interest as defined by public officers law (abstracted as a fact predicate).
% (No scenario facts supplied; left as an extensible hook.)
rptl_731_conflict_of_interest(_Officer) :- fail.

% Direct/indirect interest test per 731(2) (abstracted categories).
rptl_731_direct_or_indirect_interest(Officer, Property) :-
    (   rptl_731_interest_owner(Officer, Property)
    ->  true
    ;   rptl_731_interest_spouse_owner(Officer, Property)
    ->  true
    ;   rptl_731_interest_minor_child_owner(Officer, Property)
    ->  true
    ;   rptl_731_interest_officer_director_partner_associate_of_firm_with_financial_interest(Officer, Property)
    ->  true
    ;   false
    ).

% Extensible hooks for the statutory relationships (no scenario facts; default fail).
rptl_731_interest_owner(_Officer, _Property) :- fail.
rptl_731_interest_spouse_owner(_Officer, _Property) :- fail.
rptl_731_interest_minor_child_owner(_Officer, _Property) :- fail.
rptl_731_interest_officer_director_partner_associate_of_firm_with_financial_interest(_Officer, _Property) :- fail.

/* [2] NY Real Prop Tax L  732 (2021) - Hearing procedures (tax assessment small claims)
   Also not about eviction summons/petitions. Encoded for completeness.
*/

% Deterministic test: at least 10 working days prior notice by mail is the stated requirement,
% but failure to receive does not bar holding the hearing.
rptl_732_notice_by_mail_requirement_met(WorkingDaysPrior) :-
    integer(WorkingDaysPrior),
    (WorkingDaysPrior >= 10 -> true ; false).

% Deterministic statement of the "failure to receive notice does not bar hearing" rule.
rptl_732_failure_to_receive_notice_does_not_bar_hearing(true).

/* [3] NY Real Prop Actions L  741 (2021) - Contents of petition (eviction special proceeding)
   Encodes what "Every petition shall" state.
*/

% Deterministic list of required petition content elements under RPAPL  741.
rpapl_741_required_petition_elements([
    petitioner_interest_in_premises,              % 741(1)
    respondent_interest_and_relationship,         % 741(2)
    description_of_premises,                      % 741(3)
    facts_upon_which_proceeding_is_based,         % 741(4)
    relief_sought                                 % 741(5)
]).

% Deterministic predicate: true if an Element is required by 741.
rpapl_741_requires_petition_to_state(Element) :-
    rpapl_741_required_petition_elements(Elements),
    memberchk(Element, Elements).

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Legal reasoning layer: what must a served eviction document state?
------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

% Translate a high-level "Statement" request into a 741 "Element" when applicable.
% This is intentionally narrow to avoid assuming any additional legal requirements.
statement_to_rpapl741_element(petitioner_interest_in_premises, petitioner_interest_in_premises).
statement_to_rpapl741_element(respondent_interest_and_relationship, respondent_interest_and_relationship).
statement_to_rpapl741_element(description_of_premises, description_of_premises).
statement_to_rpapl741_element(facts_upon_which_proceeding_is_based, facts_upon_which_proceeding_is_based).
statement_to_rpapl741_element(relief_sought, relief_sought).

% The specific statement asked about in the question.
% The provided statutes do not require a summons (or petition) to state this.
requested_statement(retaliatory_eviction_is_unlawful).

/* Determine if NY (2021) requires a given DOCUMENT TYPE to state a given STATEMENT.
   - Under the provided statutes, RPAPL 741 governs PETITIONS (not "summons") and
     lists required petition contents. It does not include any requirement to state that
     retaliatory eviction is unlawful.
   - No provided statute imposes a "summons must state retaliatory eviction is unlawful" rule.
*/
ny_2021_document_must_state(DocumentType, Statement) :-
    (   DocumentType = petition
    ->  statement_to_rpapl741_element(Statement, Element),
        rpapl_741_requires_petition_to_state(Element)
    ;   % For other document types (including "summons"), the provided statutes encode no such duty.
        false
    ).

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Answer predicate
------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_document(Doc),
    scenario_document_type(Doc, DocumentType),
    requested_statement(Statement),
    ny_2021_document_must_state(DocumentType, Statement),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Main entrypoint (required)
------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).
